paragraphs.source_en: On the twenty-seventh day of the fifth month of Tenshō 15, Toyotomi Hideyoshi withdrew his troops from Satsuma and returned to Hakata. Beginning with his meeting with the Shimazu at Taiheiji on the eighth day of the fifth month, it had taken him twenty days to settle the aftermath. Only now could Hideyoshi breathe a sigh of relief, and the Shimazu, too, ought to have regained their peace of mind.
